title: The Endowment Effect
coreMove: notice when ownership has turned a neutral trade into a felt loss
sourcePressure: shows that ownership changes value and makes people demand more to give something up than to acquire it
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: making this about greed or sentimental attachment only
